No, express shipping isn't available for that plant. XL plants (usually over 4 ft, so your 5 ft bird of paradise qualifies) ship Standard only and carry an extra $20 handling fee.

Standard delivery takes 2-3 business days in Zone 1, 3-5 in Zone 2, and 5-8 in Zone 3, depending on how far you are from our nearest greenhouse. It costs $7.95, or is free if your order is $75 or more after discounts and before tax. Live plants ship Monday-Wednesday only, so orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the following Monday.
